summary: Independent review of exact 7e8a207 found two bounded correctness gaps: proof/Lease transient read failures are misclassified as permanent drift, and the legacy hook can change protected-main deleting/Active short-circuit behavior by reading the request first.
validation: v0.6.4 fixtures remain byte-identical to commit 17688f7
Request-first Consumed/absent-Lease and activation-first Issued/present-Lease envtests are present
Anomaly zero-write, CEL modern-create rejection, snapshots, and list-cardinality coverage are present
Static error-classification and protected-main routing review exposed the remaining gaps
blockers: Non-NotFound proof and issuance-Lease GET errors become ErrPermanentDrift instead of retryable ErrStateRead; Consumed must accept only an actual Lease NotFound.
Legacy hook reads the request before protected-main deletion/Active short-circuits, changing modern behavior on transient request-read failure.
next_action: Preserve deletion/Active short-circuits before the legacy hook, classify only NotFound as terminal proof/Lease drift, add focused no-write/error tests, and re-review the next exact SHA.

issues.title: Transient proof and Lease reads are treated as permanent drift
issues.details: Return ErrStateRead for non-NotFound API errors; accept absent consumed-proof Lease only when the API returns IsNotFound.

issues.title: Legacy hook precedes existing deletion and Active short-circuits
